html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 30, 2022

On Aug 29, 2022, CBEC SaaS Jijia (积加) closed a ¥132M Series A+ from Fosun RZ, Huanshi Logistics, eGarden Ventures, Yunshi, Yunqi, Zhonglin, Light Source — for R&D and premium full-channel SaaS ERP. Founded 2017 (Shenzhen); Amazon ERP + traffic/supply/brand stack. 200+ R&D, 20+ city ops centers, 200+ implementation, 96% renewal; two raises >¥200M in six months. Products: ERP-X (mid/large Amazon premium sellers — product/ops/supply/finance/mgmt) and M edition (fine ops Dashboard/ads/CS/finance/supply/APP). Thesis: premium-mode platforms out-earn listing-mode 5:1; global ecom → $8.3T by 2025.

— END —
